color_mode.description: Color mode: 'always', 'auto', or 'never' — matches the -c option behavior

graph_symbols.description: Custom graph symbols for text mode (left bracket, right bracket, fill, empty, etc.) — keys: 'left', 'right', 'fill', 'empty'. Each value must be a single character string.

colors.description: Custom colors for fields: 'header', 'total', 'filesystem', 'size', 'used', 'avail', 'use%', 'mount'. Values are HTML hex codes or ANSI color names.

export_colors.description: Custom colors used specifically in HTML export — same field keys as 'colors'.
